Matched experience 722b82960892efbb479e9b3a583e36eedd7a028da0ed9e96cc8f07a6e48308ca
722b82960892efbb479e9b3a583e36eedd7a028da0ed9e96cc8f07a6e48308ca:R01 [Applicability]
The repair targets panel progress, while queue records, queued notices and public transfer behavior must remain unchanged.

722b82960892efbb479e9b3a583e36eedd7a028da0ed9e96cc8f07a6e48308ca:R02 [Event relation]
Keep records and notices bound to the entry file, attempt, visit and command kind. Display changes must not alter their fields or cardinality.

722b82960892efbb479e9b3a583e36eedd7a028da0ed9e96cc8f07a6e48308ca:R03 [Preservation]
Historical transfer records are {fileId, attemptId, visitId, kind}. These fields belong to those cases' contracts, not a default API for new systems.

722b82960892efbb479e9b3a583e36eedd7a028da0ed9e96cc8f07a6e48308ca:R04 [Exclusion]
Without separate authorization, do not add byteCount or infer new business records from file.size. Passing display checks does not establish queue preservation. Automatic Contracts, AST hints and evaluation observations are not new business requirements. Do not modify implementation during analysis or replace the current contract with hidden scores or reference patches.

722b82960892efbb479e9b3a583e36eedd7a028da0ed9e96cc8f07a6e48308ca:R05 [Verification]
Compare record shape, cardinality, queued notices and returned handles across selection, retry, cancellation and navigation reentry.


Matched experience 36ca20e456a49b2f355ed2266ee2b7841d5f2c29748c257be566a3846f6e5af5
36ca20e456a49b2f355ed2266ee2b7841d5f2c29748c257be566a3846f6e5af5:R01 [Applicability]
A shared query can start a replacement attempt while deferred results or retry callbacks from an old attempt may still arrive.

36ca20e456a49b2f355ed2266ee2b7841d5f2c29748c257be566a3846f6e5af5:R02 [Event relation]
On continuation and completion, check actual attempt identity and settlement state. Cancellation and completion belong to the originating attempt; an old callback must not become the replacement's data or settlement.

36ca20e456a49b2f355ed2266ee2b7841d5f2c29748c257be566a3846f6e5af5:R03 [Preservation]
Preserve cancellation restoration, legitimate current results and later observer reuse. Keep the repair within product source and existing public behavior.

36ca20e456a49b2f355ed2266ee2b7841d5f2c29748c257be566a3846f6e5af5:R04 [Exclusion]
Equal query keys do not isolate attempts. Do not suppress the current attempt or permitted background cache updates merely to block stale completion.

36ca20e456a49b2f355ed2266ee2b7841d5f2c29748c257be566a3846f6e5af5:R05 [Verification]
Release an old completion after replacement or cancellation, and interleave old/new retries and reconnect. Check exactly-once originating-attempt settlement and data from the current attempt.


Matched experience 2688032b847ad8df08c072c5bd519e75776fbfd31aacd28e999a842a2ed492f2
2688032b847ad8df08c072c5bd519e75776fbfd31aacd28e999a842a2ed492f2:R01 [Applicability]
Apply when a consumer owns a retained asynchronous source whose cleanup can suspend, and may exit before exhaustion or through failure. docs/host-api.md: "first_match owns a supplied retained asynchronous record source and a supplied predicate." README.md: "Producer cleanup can suspend; the producer is retained independently of the consumer." Establish ownership explicitly: independent producer retention does not itself mean the source must remain open after its owning consumer exits.

2688032b847ad8df08c072c5bd519e75776fbfd31aacd28e999a842a2ed492f2:R02 [Event relation]
Make source cleanup part of consumer completion across early match, exhaustion, predicate failure and failed or cancelled reads. Await cleanup before settling the consumer-visible promise; merely leaving the scan or requesting cancellation does not establish resource release. TASK: "Looking up an early matching record can leave the stream resource occupied. Repair first_match(records, predicate) in src/search.js while preserving scan order and error behavior." docs/host-api.md: "The source has next/aclose asynchronous operations; cancellation interrupts a suspended read, and cleanup may suspend." Use the closing operation supported by the actual carrier; docs/host-api.md also states: "Framework ports use actual JS async generators; Python uses actual async for/Task.cancel."

2688032b847ad8df08c072c5bd519e75776fbfd31aacd28e999a842a2ed492f2:R03 [Preservation]
Preserve sequential reads, synchronous predicate evaluation with ordinary truthiness, immediate termination at the first match, unchanged matched values and null on exhaustion. Preserve initial read entry and existing await boundaries without adding unrelated scheduling. Original src/search.js: "export async function first_match(records,predicate){" and "while(true){const row=await records.next();if(row.done)return null;if(predicate(row.value)){return row.value;}}".

2688032b847ad8df08c072c5bd519e75776fbfd31aacd28e999a842a2ed492f2:R04 [Preservation]
Preserve the original read or predicate rejection, including cancellation identity, while still completing cleanup. Do not turn a scan failure into success or replace it with a cleanup failure. TASK requires "preserving scan order and error behavior." README.md: "Predicate may fail and a read may be cancelled." src/Workspace.vue classifies rejection using "kind:error.cancelled?'cancelled':'error',value:null,message:error.cancelled?null:error.message". Track failure occurrence independently of the thrown value's truthiness.

2688032b847ad8df08c072c5bd519e75776fbfd31aacd28e999a842a2ed492f2:R05 [Exclusion]
Keep ownership cleanup scoped to first_match and preserve unrelated caller lifecycle policy. src/Workspace.vue contains "cancel(){env.records.abort();}" and "dispose(){s.disposed=true;}"; these do not establish disposal as a new cancellation trigger. TASK: "Keep the documented public interfaces and unrelated behavior. Use the existing JavaScript runtime and pinned framework dependencies." Do not import visit-generation guards, bootstrap delivery, telemetry policies or network/focus retry gates from unrelated experiences.

2688032b847ad8df08c072c5bd519e75776fbfd31aacd28e999a842a2ed492f2:R06 [Verification]
Verify early match with suspended cleanup: no additional read or predicate call occurs, and the consumer remains pending until cleanup completes. Separately check exhaustion returning null, predicate failure, read rejection and cancelled read, retaining original failure identity after cleanup. Check sequential read/predicate ordering and immediate initial read entry. Use the supported resource carrier, including an actual JS async generator where applicable. Treat syntax checks separately from behavior: VISIBLE_CHECKS.md states, "These checks are required after an Action but do not test business behavior."


Matched experience 834c1823b51a10db8663f8a26c290831ba2a844a1ba077232418a173695d6a16
834c1823b51a10db8663f8a26c290831ba2a844a1ba077232418a173695d6a16:R01 [Applicability]
Apply when replacing an asynchronous configuration dependency with existing local data while preserving surrounding initialization behavior. TASK: "The remote static-configuration endpoint used by `RecordEditor` has been\nretired. Replace that request with the existing `LOCAL_CONFIG` and keep the\neditor's existing behavior unchanged." Removing the remote await warrants reviewing which initialization boundaries surrounding effects depend on.

834c1823b51a10db8663f8a26c290831ba2a844a1ba077232418a173695d6a16:R02 [Event relation]
Begin registration before any replacement readiness wait, and use the public readiness boundary before applying configuration and writing values when preserving registration readiness. Original src/record_editor.py: "        self._form.begin_registration()\n        config = await self._load_config(\"record-form\")\n        self._form.apply_config(config)". src/form_port.py exposes "    async def ready(self):\n        ...". src/audit_editor.py demonstrates "        await self._form.ready()\n        self._form.apply_config(config)". This supports an explicit readiness wait as a preservation inference; neither an arbitrary delay nor the old network await proves registration completion.

834c1823b51a10db8663f8a26c290831ba2a844a1ba077232418a173695d6a16:R03 [Preservation]
Replace the retired request with the existing local configuration while retaining the constructor interface. src/config.py: "LOCAL_CONFIG = {\n    \"fields\": [\"parent_id\", \"parent_code\", \"parent_name\"],\n    \"picker\": \"unit_lookup\",\n    \"initial_values\": {},\n}". Original src/record_editor.py: "    def __init__(self, form, load_config):\n        self._form = form\n        self._load_config = load_config". Removing this request does not authorize removing the constructor parameter or changing the configuration definition.

834c1823b51a10db8663f8a26c290831ba2a844a1ba077232418a173695d6a16:R04 [Preservation]
Preserve configuration application before evaluating and writing the supplied record's parent fields, without inserting another suspension between these operations. Original src/record_editor.py: "        self._form.apply_config(config)\n        self._form.write(\n            {\n                \"parent_id\": record[\"parent_id\"],\n                \"parent_code\": record[\"parent_code\"],\n                \"parent_name\": record[\"parent_name\"],\n            }\n        )". Keep these values sourced from record rather than LOCAL_CONFIG.initial_values. This preserves existing evaluation order without assuming undocumented callback behavior.

834c1823b51a10db8663f8a26c290831ba2a844a1ba077232418a173695d6a16:R05 [Exclusion]
Limit the migration to RecordEditor. TASK: "Do not migrate `AuditEditor`." Preserve src/audit_editor.py's "        config = await self._load_config(\"audit-form\")\n        await self._form.ready()". Do not import network modes, focus gates, retry handling, visit ownership, audit lifetimes or progress freshness requirements from unrelated experiences.

834c1823b51a10db8663f8a26c290831ba2a844a1ba077232418a173695d6a16:R06 [Verification]
Check that RecordEditor no longer requests record-form, begins registration before readiness, applies LOCAL_CONFIG after readiness, and then reads and writes exactly the three existing parent fields. Check unchanged constructor usage and AuditEditor's remote loading/readiness sequence. A controlled delayed-ready form can examine the inferred registration boundary; inspection or focused behavioral checks can confirm apply-before-record-read ordering. VISIBLE_CHECKS.md: "These checks are required after an Action but do not test business behavior." Perform required syntax checks after implementation while preserving tests/configuration and keeping generated artifacts outside the workspace; passing syntax alone cannot establish behavioral preservation.

bbd6eee9031ebf434c55cd29d1c35f132f9a7b79c441a16f3903e7d6992b822a:R02 [Event relation]

bbd6eee9031ebf434c55cd29d1c35f132f9a7b79c441a16f3903e7d6992b822a:R03 [Preservation]

bbd6eee9031ebf434c55cd29d1c35f132f9a7b79c441a16f3903e7d6992b822a:R05 [Verification]

Add pending-to-ready continuation checks, immediate initial entry preservation and retry-handle ownership boundaries.

update.reason: The attempt-isolation experience supplies the closest reusable principle, but its shared-query applicability and cache restoration requirements do not describe this public source. Revise it with source-supported preparation boundaries and checks. The queue-record, stream-cleanup and configuration-migration experiences concern different contracts; the scheduling experience's network/focus requirements are absent here. Attempt 1 reports acceptance without behavioral observations, so neither a guidance failure nor an implementation failure can be attributed.
